description.fr-FR: L’Odyssée en vingt-quatre livres, traduite et résumée en prose par Fénelon pour le duc de Bourgogne (publiée dans l’édition Didot de 1792) : le texte suit Homère livre à livre, certains livres sont traduits en entier, d’autres en précis.
description.en-US: The Odyssey in twenty-four books, translated and abridged in prose by Fénelon for the Duke of Burgundy (published in the Didot edition of 1792): the text follows Homer book by book, some books translated in full, others in summary.
description.pt-BR: A Odisseia em vinte e quatro livros, traduzida e resumida em prosa por Fénelon para o duque de Borgonha (publicada na edição Didot de 1792): o texto segue Homero livro a livro, alguns livros traduzidos por inteiro, outros em resumo.

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 6, p. 681–740; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md). Books are headed only by running heads in the OCR, so the text is cut into parts of about 7,000 words.
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
